text_block_list.text:
Just listen to that crowd! The cheers of
those
excited to see the birth of a
champion echo
throughout the grounds!

text_block_list.text:
Who will be this year's Derby
Champion? The
Japanese Derby is
starting soon!

have to
focus.

text_block_list.text:
I have only one goal, and one goal
only—to catch
up to Bourbon.

text_block_list.text: Thank you, Big Brother. I'm off.
